units.title: Deterministic Python contracts
units.objective: Translate a written input/output/error contract into a pure Python 3.12 implementation with canonical JSON output and deterministic failures.

exercise.summary: Implement a pure function that accepts a versioned JSON object, returns canonical JSON for valid input, and emits stable error codes for invalid input.

project_task.summary: Build a local contract validator with no wall-clock, network, random, database or shell dependency.

acceptance: The implementation is deterministic across two clean replays.
At least one normal, boundary and invalid fixture has an explicit expected result.
Invalid input returns a stable error code without partial output.
The learner explains which input fields form the contract boundary.

triggers: Northstar v2 contract receives a versioned correction
A learner fixture exposes an ambiguous boundary

limitations: Content and CI readiness do not prove learner mastery.
The task is local and does not prove service or production behavior.

units.title: Boundary, failure, test and evidence engineering
units.objective: Design reproducible normal, boundary and negative tests, preserve failure evidence, and distinguish a green reference run from learner mastery.

exercise.summary: Extend the Unit 1 validator with table-driven boundary/negative tests and a compact evidence record that separates facts, failures, corrections and limitations.

project_task.summary: Run the validator twice in a clean environment, compare outputs byte-for-byte, and explain what the run proves and does not prove.

acceptance: Tests cover normal, lower/upper boundary and invalid paths.
The failing fixture is retained and passes only after a targeted correction.
Two clean replays produce byte-identical result output.
The evidence summary does not claim mastery from resources or CI.

triggers: Evidence review finds an untested failure class

limitations: Reference tests and generated content do not prove independent learner authorship or mastery.
Proof remains unchanged until the learner produces and submits real evidence.
